entities.name: Zumaki of the Bottomless Pool
entities.description: Old dragon engine of Dominaria who enslaved pixies for visions.

entities.name: Mak Fawa
entities.description: Phyrexian infiltrator dragon that attacked Zumaki.

entities.name: Vaan
entities.description: Last surviving pixie, forced to hide the new dragon's body in a glamor.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the Mak Fawa probably arrived.

events.summary: Zumaki enslaved pixies to give him glamor visions.
events.quote: He enslaved a group of pixies and had them give him fanciful visions

events.summary: Zumaki tried to take over an attacking Mak Fawa with his mind; both died and the backlash exploded Zumaki's head.
events.quote: the backlash made Zumaki's head explode

events.summary: A new dragon formed from the remains terrorized the countryside while Vaan hid it in a glamor; dragonslayers failed to destroy it.
events.quote: a new dragon was created with the body of the Mak Fawa and a twisted version of Zumaki's mind

relations.quote: Zumaki was attacked by a Mak Fawa
